facts.text: I'm the maid of honour and dinner is totally under control. I've checked the meat twice, so nobody panic.
facts.why: Annie never says this. The quote page I opened lists her real lines and this is not one. It is printed in quote marks as her words. The joke fits the film (Annie booked the Brazilian steakhouse), so keep it as a note with no quote marks.
facts.fix: I'm the maid of honour and lunch is under control. I checked the meat twice, so nobody panic.
